mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below its 3-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the correlation between GDPC1 decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals expanding supply capacity, which tends to depress profit margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in lower earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between INDPRO expansion and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 6-month moving average signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the correlation between UNRATE rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below its 6-month moving average signals monetary easing, which tends to boost equity valuations through lower discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decline and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which tends to depress corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the correlation between RSAFS decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average signals expanding housing demand and construction activity, which tends to boost related sectors and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between HOUST rise and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the payroll employment series (PAYEMS) above its 6-month moving average signals labor market strength, which tends to boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the correlation between PAYEMS rise and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above its 6-month moving average signals inflationary pressures, which tend to lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
